modules.summary: Team labour costs: logged hours times daily rates, per person and month, split by area, epic and issue.
A small module for trying out sync: a note saved here becomes a file in the team data repository and reaches the team through the encrypted mirror on the next sync.
Flow metrics for an engineering team from Jira: work in progress, throughput, lead and cycle time, and epic cycle time.
A weekly Gantt chart for a quarterly plan: tasks, areas, phases, a backlog and an HTML export to share outside the app.
A read-only browser of discovery documents in the team data repository: interviews, research, requirements and UX briefs.
A searchable directory of locations with a full card per location and a one-file import from Excel or CSV.
An archive of processed meetings: folders, search, summaries and transcripts, fed by the Meeting transcripts module.
Turns meeting recordings into a transcript with speaker labels and a summary, and picks up new recordings on a schedule.
A monthly on-call calendar read from a configurable wiki page: who is on call today, contacts and on-call hours.
Helpful links and individual onboarding plans for new team members, built from a template and exportable to a file.
Open production bugs and mean time to fix per sprint for several product areas, fetched from Jira.
Test automation coverage: test case status per product area, regression runs and time saved by automation, fetched from Jira.
A responsibility matrix: groups, areas, owners and a status rating for the chosen month, per project.
A roadmap of discovery initiatives: an editable table with drag-and-drop ordering, a timeline and a board view.
A rollout planned in weekly waves across the locations directory, with training progress and coordination per wave.
Sprint planning per team: on-call, capacity and holidays, absences, and a velocity proposal from Sprint Stats.
Sprint Review coordination for several teams: sessions, topics, sprint goal status and a countdown to the review.
Commitment versus delivery per team and per person: sprint tabs, goals, tiles and an issue table.
A team roster with contact details: team cards, member photos, search by person or role, and contact by e-mail or chat.
Who on the team logged time over the last 14 days: a person by day heatmap with issues, time off and a reminder draft.
The team time-off calendar, downloaded from a configurable spreadsheet after a Microsoft sign-in.
Mission Deck usage from Amplitude: active people, sessions, page views and time, per module and per user.
Vendor settlements and acceptance protocols per area: costs versus accepted work, a settlement form against a purchase order pool and a filtered list.
